messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: runtime-release parity-check failed for rollout 'release/2026-03-17/blue' on canary pool eu-west-1-canary

deploy-bot: Canary failures exceed threshold (20%) — automatic fallback policy triggered but some pods still returning garbled logits. See /deploy/3123456789

alex: oncall here, looking. can someone drop the canary sample id and a few failing request ids?

maria: grabbing logs from canary node gc3-09, dumping model metadata and tokenizer header now

maria: ```
model_artifact: release/2026-03-17/blue/weights-v2.1
tokenizer_version: tok-v2026-01
bundle_checksum: sha256:3f8a9b...
expected_tokenizer_hash: sha256:7b2c11...
observed_tokenizer_hash: sha256:7b2c11... (OK)
observed_weight_layout: channel_first
runtime_expected_layout: channel_last
```

ajex: (typo) alex: wow layer-order mismatch — weights layout differs from runtime expectation. that explains garbled outputs.

alex: confirmed. so this release shipped a weightpack with channel_first ordering but runtime expects channel_last. probably a packing tool flag flipped in build pipeline.

sam: tagging ops-bot to open hotfix runbook and escalate if rollback not possible in 10m @ops-bot

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-0176. Pager duty notified. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-parity

jess: customer impact: we've received 3 distinct customer reports of incoherent completions (priority: mid). A/B tests show spike in error-rate for 5% of conversational traffic and >20% on canary. No billing/latency SLO breaches yet.

maria: quick check: can we hot-rotate to a compatible runtime shim that handles channel_first layout? that would avoid full rollback if safe. patch would take ~15-20m to compile and validate.

sam: compile path risky during peak — prefer rollback to last-good artifact v2026-03-10-hotfix-7 which was validated. rollback ETA ~5m if we trigger the reserved rollback path.

alex: agree. initiate kill-switch + rollback. I'll flip release feature flag and trigger k8s rollout revert.

alex: /run: featureflag toggle release/2026-03-17/blue parity_enforce false --actor alex --reason "rollback parity-breaker"

deploy-bot: featureflag: release/2026-03-17/blue.parity_enforce set to false by alex

alex: /run: rollout revert release/2026-03-17/blue --to-tag v2026-03-10-hotfix-7 --force --actor alex
deploy-bot: Revert job queued: job_id=rb-3123456791. Rolling pods in eu-west-1-canary -> eu-west-1-prod. Progress: 0/12

maria: watching logs for successful model mount on first pod. tailing mount logs...

maria: pod gc3-09: mount ok, weights v2026-03-10-hotfix-7, tokenizer tok-v2026-01 verified. model init ok. health check passed.

deploy-bot: Progress: 6/12 pods reverted. Canary error-rate trending down to 3%

jess: notifying CS about mitigation: short note to customers affected with ETA for full rollback and apology. drafting now.

sam: ops-bot, please mark sustained rollback and monitor embedding sim stability for the next 30m.

ops-bot: Monitoring alarms enabled for metrics: output-coherency, perplexity-spike, serving-errors. Alert threshold set to 5% for canary group.

alex: All canary pods done. Progress: 12/12. Canary error-rate back to baseline 0.6%. Rolling to prod in controlled window (5% traffic increment every 2m).

maria: quick post-rollout check: sample request ids from earlier are now returning expected token sequences. verifying unit prompts.

maria: sample-confirmation: PASS x 25. no garbled logits.

jess: CS msg sent to affected customers: "We've detected an issue with today's model rollout that affected a subset of traffic. We reverted to the previous validated model and are monitoring. No customer data was exposed. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

sam: creating follow-up ticket in infra: INFRA-3123 to add a CI parity check that compares weight layout and tokenizer header before promotion.

alex: adding blameless postmortem owners: maria (runtime), sam (deploy pipeline), devops (CI). Expect doc in 48h.

jess: closing summary: kill-switch used, canary rollback completed, customers notified, monitoring in place. Recommend holding new rollout until parity CI landed.

alex: thanks team. leaving oncall to sam. signed-off. :white_check_mark:

sam: oncall ack, will watch for 60m then handback.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0317-0176 updated: status=mitigated, severity=low-mid, lead=alex, impact_summary="garbled outputs on canary due to weight layout mismatch, rollback completed, customers notified"

alex: marking thread resolved for now. will link postmortem when ready.
